extracted.intended_audience: general readers of 19th-century travel literature / readers interested in Persia and travel narratives
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from a 19th-century travelogue describing Persian tales, customs (beards, mustaches), local legends (ghools), Persian poets (Firdousee, Sâdee, Hâfiz), and the Mission's approach to Teheran. It's a literary/historical travel account rather than guidance or evaluative criteria.
